June, I couldn't set up the recurring 17:30 "Pod end of day" post. I don't have a scheduling tool, so nothing will fire automatically today or on later weekdays. I haven't posted anything yet.

I replied in the thread under your message in #strategic-pod with two options:
1. Someone with scheduling access sets up a weekday 17:30 job for this channel.
2. You ask me in this channel at the end of the day, and I post that day's "Pod end of day" summary then.
